nodes.hint_edit: When the file holds both a biopsy taken before chemotherapy and a resection taken after it, code from the biopsy: after chemotherapy about 20% of hepatoblastomas show areas that mimic hepatocellular carcinoma (López-Terrada 2025, p. 27).

options.label_head: Referral letter or clinical note only — no imaging report, no cytology
options.rationale: Lowest tier. It fits any set with no Imaging Report, Cytology or Histology Report, so nothing ticked, a referral alone, and a lone Lab Report, IHC Report or Gene report all land here. Lab, IHC and genetics are deliberately not excluded: they cannot raise a tier without the document they are read against, and excluding them would dead-end those sets.

options.label_head: Ultrasound, CT or MRI report, with or without a serum alpha-fetoprotei
options.rationale: Requires the Imaging Report and excludes the two tissue documents to honour 'no tissue'. The label says 'with or without' serum alpha-fetoprotein, so Lab Report is optional and is not required; the next node (hp_imaging_pathway) asks for the actual marker result. IHC or genetics ticked beside imaging without a tissue document stay at this tier, which understates.

options.label_head: Histology report from a needle or wedge biopsy, a resection, a transpl
options.rationale: Fits every set that holds the Histology Report, whatever else is ticked, so it is the highest tier and the only fit for those sets. IHC and genetics refine the histology tier only beside the Histology Report, and need no separate option here.

options.label_head: Fine-needle aspiration or other cytology report only — no histology re
options.rationale: Requires the Cytology document itself and excludes Histology Report to honour 'no histology report'. Imaging may also be ticked, because cytology outranks imaging in the old ladder. IHC beside cytology stays here (immunocytochemistry), as does genetics.

options.label_head: A specimen was taken but is reported inadequate, non-diagnostic or uni
options.rationale: An inadequate, non-diagnostic or uninterpretable specimen is a situation that does not follow from which documents exist, so it is a context option with no tick rules. The clerk can choose it with any ticked set.

nodes.hint_was: Pick the highest tier of evidence genuinely in the file. When the file holds both a biopsy taken before chemotherapy and a resection taken after it, code from the biopsy: after chemotherapy about 20% of hepatoblastomas show areas that mimic hepatocellular carcinoma (López-Terrada 2025, p. 27).
